text:
The Ann–Ben block is consecutive, with Cara before Elif before Ann before Hana, and Gus after Ben. Ann–Gus at least three apart forces Gus at least three after Ann, so Ann is no later than 6. Cara and Elif need two slots before Ann, and Ben, Hana, and Gus need three after her.

Ann in 3, 4, or 5 leaves Dev too close to Ann, Ben, Cara, or Gus. Ann in 6, Ben in 7, Gus in 9, and Hana in 8 is the only block that fits. Slots 1–5 then hold Dev, Finn, Ivo, Cara, and Elif. Dev must be at least three from Ann, so Dev is in 1–3. Finn, Ivo, and Cara must each be at least three from Ben, so they are in 1–4, which puts Elif in 5. Elif–Finn at least three apart puts Finn in 1–2. Finn in 1 leaves no slot for Cara that is at least three from Dev. Finn in 2, Dev in 1, and Cara in 4 (three from Dev and from Ben) leaves Ivo in 3.

SCHEDULE: {"1":"Dev","2":"Finn","3":"Ivo","4":"Cara","5":"Elif","6":"Ann","7":"Ben","8":"Hana","9":"Gus"}
CONFIDENCE: 98
